author: Rob Keck (knkwebservices)
description: Fallout 76 utility commands: current nuke launch codes (via NukaCrypt) and Minerva's rotation schedule.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Fallout76! Try `[p]nukes` to see today's launch codes, or `[p]minerva` for her schedule. Admins can manage the Minerva schedule with `[p]minervaset`.
short: Fallout 76 nuke codes and Minerva schedule.
